13311.story: As of Oct 16, cropland in White County rents for $53 an acre in 2026, against a state median of $58, which puts it 48th lowest of 105. The census value of land and buildings was $11,468 an acre in 2022, up 41.1% from $8,126 in 2017, or 7.1% a year. That ranks 3rd highest of 135 in Georgia, well over the $4,057 state median. Pasture rents for $40 an acre in 2026.

13313.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Whitfield County is $28 an acre for 2026, tied for 5th lowest of 105 in Georgia, where the state median is $58. That rent was $24 in 2016, so it is up 14.6% since then. The census value of land and buildings was $6,983 an acre in 2022, up 12.9% from $6,185 in 2017, and that value ranks 22nd highest of 135.

13315.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Wilcox County runs $125 an acre for 2026, up 86.6% from $67 in 2016. That rent ranks 2nd highest of 105 in Georgia, where the state median is $58. The census value of land and buildings was $2,832 an acre in 2022, up 8.6% from $2,608 in 2017, and it ranks 13th lowest of 135 in the state. Corn made 197.0 bu in 2025, above the long run median of 186.2 bu.

13317.story: As of Oct 16, cropland rent in Wilkes County runs $24 an acre for 2026, the 3rd lowest of 105 against a state median of $58. That rent sat at $22 in 2016, so it is up 9.3% in ten years. The census value of land and buildings was $3,614 an acre in 2022, up 4.8% from $3,447 in 2017, or 1.0% a year. That value ranks 52nd lowest of 135 against a state median of $4,057.

13319.story: As of Oct 16, Wilkinson County cash rent ran $41 an acre in 2024. The census value of land and buildings was $2,292 an acre in 2022, up 11.8% from $2,050 in 2017, or 2.3% a year. That sits well under the state median of $4,057 and ranks lowest of 135 counties in Georgia. Only 5% of farmland here was rented in 2022.

13321.story: As of Oct 16, cash rent in Worth County runs $113 an acre for 2026, tied for 8th highest of 105 in Georgia and well above the $58 state median. That is up 29.9% from $87 in 2016. The census value of land and buildings came to $3,837 an acre in 2022, up 27.8% from $3,003 in 2017. Corn made 181.5 bu in 2024, a touch under the county median of 183.1 bu going back to 2008.
